result.title: MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs
result.comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. To appear in the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
result.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on long contexts, making Key-Value (KV) caches dominate memory usage and inference latency. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods effectively compress KV caches to sub-4-bit levels but often overlook inefficiencies in memory alignment and decoding speed. This work introduces MeltKV, a memory-latency co-optimized KV cache quantization framework for long-context LLM serving. MeltKV employs a memory-aligned variable-bit index packing scheme that adaptively assigns bit-widths to grouped key channels and compactly stores indices within standard data-types, eliminating redundant bits. Additionally, head-wise codebook sharing reduces the total codebook size while maintaining accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that MeltKV effectively compresses KV representations to sub-4-bit levels down to 1 bit and, at comparable perplexity, achieves 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency than state-of-the-art VQ methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MeltKV，面向长上下文 LLM 服务对 KV cache 做可变比特向量量化：按分组 key 通道自适应分配位宽，将索引紧凑打包进标准数据类型以消除冗余位，并用逐头码本共享缩小码本总量，在困惑度相当下把 KV 压到 1–4 bit 以下并降低显存与延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其低位 KV 量化与码本共享可能为 LVR 中缓存视觉证据或 latent 推理状态提供存储与成本线索，但论文不涉及视觉推理，需核查量化误差是否损坏推理所需状态内容。
